products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Our product portfolio
products.intro: Four film series for different requirements — from maximum heat rejection to highest clarity. Depending on series and tint, visible light transmittance (VLT) from 5% to 95% is available.
products.legend: VLT = Visible Light Transmittance · TSER = Total Solar Energy Rejected

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: How solar-control film works
howItWorks.intro: Example values on 3 mm clear glass — exact figures vary by tint and product.
howItWorks.withoutTitle: 3 mm clear glass without window film
howItWorks.withTitle: 3 mm clear glass with our film
howItWorks.exampleProduct: Example: Armolan R Silver 20 — TSER 78%, UV protection >99%, glare reduction 81%
howItWorks.uvStep3: Furniture, floors and merchandise stay protected
howItWorks.securityIntro: On impact, the film distributes the force across the entire glass surface. Even if the glass breaks, the film holds the shards together.
howItWorks.forceTitle: Force is distributed across the entire window surface
howItWorks.forceCaption: The glass stays in the frame even under strong impact — the film makes the window more resistant
howItWorks.withoutSecurity: Glass without security film — shards detach and fall out
howItWorks.withSecurity: Glass with security film — force is distributed, shards stay together

serie-r.name: Serie R
serie-r.technology: Metallised reflective layer (aluminium) — acts like a mirror against solar heat
serie-r.description: Metallised coating (aluminium) — effectively reflects solar heat like a mirror. Available in Silver, Grey, Bronze, Blue, Green, Gold and other tints.
serie-r.idealFor: Residential and commercial buildings with strong solar exposure

arm-platinum-spectrum.name: ARM Platinum / Spectrum
arm-platinum-spectrum.technology: Nano-ceramic coating — blocks solar energy through fine, densely applied particles rather than reflecting it, resulting in a brighter, more transparent look.
arm-platinum-spectrum.description: Dense particle coating — blocks solar energy instead of reflecting it, resulting in particularly bright and transparent glass.
arm-platinum-spectrum.idealFor: Shopfronts, car dealerships, retail — where clarity matters

safety-serie.name: Safety Serie
safety-serie.description: Increased impact resistance — holds glass shards together on breakage and deters intrusion. Available in 4 / 7 / 8 / 12 / 13 mil (100–336 µm).
safety-serie.idealFor: Ground-floor and shopfront windows, security-sensitive areas

uv-protection-clear.name: UV Protection Clear
uv-protection-clear.description: Up to 99.9% UV protection at maximum clarity — ideal for premium displays.
